audit.whatIsWrong: The diff enum says HARD while the tone is green (#3ddc97), diffRating is 4/10, and breakdown.difficulty and report[14] both say 'Favoured matchup'. Separately, rows 2, 3 and 5 read Yorick while their own why text says you root him freely, out-poke and out-clear him, and delete him at first item.
audit.why: Packet chart is [Skill, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Yorick] at 83.33% over 12 games. content 'mid' says 'This is your lane to take over.' Yorick has no dash and a 700-range poke against your 800/1000 — the middle rows are not his.
audit.corrected: diff HARD to FAVOURED; row 0 to Skill, rows 1-5 to Neeko, row 6 stays Yorick, as one atomic pair-matched group.

audit.why: Four spikes: Lvl 3 Q+E, Lvl 6 Pop Blossom, 1st item Liandry's/Blackfire, Late his splitpush. The late hand-off is real — Eulogy of the Isles is 160s at rank 1 but 100s at rank 3, so the Maiden becomes a permanent lane presence rather than an event.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer consistently calls Yorick's E the 'mist-cage' and treats it as the trapping tool. The cage is W (Dark Procession); E (Mourning Mist) is a 700-range globule that shreds armour, slows and marks you.
audit.why: Riot: W — 'summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement', 20/18/16/14/12s. E — 'throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets', 12/11/10/9/8s. The mark is what makes his ghouls sprint at you, so eating E is the tell that the swarm is coming — a different decision than being walled in.
audit.corrected: W named as the cage, E named as the armour-shred mark that accelerates his Mist Walkers.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d calls a spent Dark Procession a 'fifteen-second invitation'; it is 20/18/16/14/12s.
audit.why: 20s at rank 1 is the real punish window, and it is the cooldown the whole page tells you to count.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears only in report[8]; the content layer never mentions Grievous Wounds despite Last Rites healing him on a 4s cooldown at rank 5.
audit.why: Last Rites is both his heal and an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is the tell that his trade has started, and the heal is why chip poke alone does not push him out of lane.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal and the Q reset folded into whys[3].

edits.before: Yorick burns Dark Procession (Cage) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Yorick burns Dark Procession (Cage) on nothing — that is a 20s invitation at rank 1.

edits.before: You out-poke and out-clear him with Q's AoE, thinning his ghouls while pressuring him on every E cooldown.
edits.after: You out-poke and out-clear him, thinning the ghouls — Last Rites (Q) heals on a 6s reset, so buy anti-heal.

edits.before: Yorick out-scales as a splitpush juggernaut — Maiden, ghouls, W wall and E mist-cage zone you off the side lane and outlast your single rotation.
edits.after: Yorick out-scales as a splitpush juggernaut — Maiden, ghouls, the Dark Procession cage and Mourning Mist's slow outlast your single rotation.

edits.before: Liandry's / Blackfire Torch: your Q AoE shreds Maiden and ghouls instantly and your burst deletes him before his mist cage (E) traps you.
edits.after: Liandry's / Blackfire Torch: your Q AoE shreds Maiden and ghouls instantly and your burst deletes him before Dark Procession (W) cages you.

edits.before: Yorick's window — full-build splitpush with Maiden, W wall and E mist-cage zone you off the side lane and his sustained DPS outlasts your single rotation.
edits.after: Yorick's window — full-build splitpush: Maiden, the Dark Procession cage and Mourning Mist's armour shred zone you off the side lane and outlast your rotation.

edits.before: Drop his E mist-cage and W wall to trap you in melee so his ghouls and Maiden swarm you down
edits.after: Drop Dark Procession (W) to cage you in melee so his ghouls and the Maiden swarm you down

edits.before: Yorick can't dash, so your E (Tangle-Barbs) is a free root once you hit level 3 — but don't waste it on the ghoul swarm. At level 1 he can corner you with E mist-cage if you walk up greedy, so farm with the tip of Q (Blooming Burst) and clear his ghouls with the re-bloom rather than letting them stack. Once you have Q+E, wait for him to walk up to last-hit, root him, and drop Q on the spot — he physically cannot leave the seed before it blooms again.
edits.after: Yorick can't dash, so your E (Tangle-Barbs) is a free root once you hit level 3 — but don't waste it on the ghoul swarm. Mourning Mist (E) marks you and his Mist Walkers sprint at whatever it hits, so eating it is the tell the swarm is coming: farm with the tip of Q (Blooming Burst) and clear the ghouls with the re-bloom. Once you have Q+E, wait for him to walk up to last-hit, root him, and drop Q on the spot — he cannot leave the seed before it blooms again.

notes: Two structural fixes: diff said HARD while every other difficulty signal on the page said favoured 4/10, and the content layer had Yorick's E and W swapped throughout — the cage is Dark Procession (W, 20s at rank 1), and Mourning Mist (E, 700 range, 12s at rank 1) is the armour-shred mark that makes his Mist Walkers charge you. Chart rows 0-5 proposed as one atomic pair-matched group. Flag misfire worth recording: the kit file tags Yorick's E with 'dash', but Riot's description gives the movement speed to his summoned units, not to Yorick. The pages' repeated 'dashless Yorick' claim matches the description, so I kept it and did not act on the flag. Unverified champion-wide and left alone: 'W-clone' invisibility phrasing in spikes[1] and mid.
